fusions.name: Butting Round
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 16 damage and is knocked back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Short Jab
fusions.desc: A quick jab that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Staked Footing
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Planted Hooves
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stake is driven in, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 5% of your maximum health per stake (30% at full). Unfed, a stake fades every 8 seconds.
